metadata.source: Public bug bounty program patterns, our synthesis
metadata.provenance: Synthesized from public program scopes (HackerOne, Bugcrowd public), no private data

patterns.interpretation: All subdomains of target.com in scope, plus target.com itself
patterns.testing_approach: Enum subdomains via crt.sh, DNS, etc., test each subdomain within scope, respect exclusions

patterns.interpretation: API endpoints in scope, need to test for BOLA, BFLA, etc.
patterns.testing_approach: Discover API endpoints via docs, JS, spidering, test for API Top 10

patterns.interpretation: Mobile app in scope, need to test API backend, mobile-specific issues
patterns.testing_approach: Decompile APK/IPA (if authorized), check API endpoints, check for hardcoded secrets (but we check for exposure, not extraction beyond minimal)

examples: Accessing other users' PII beyond minimal proof
patterns.interpretation: These are typically out-of-scope or require approval, need to check program scope
patterns.testing_approach: Avoid out-of-scope, request approval for high-impact, minimal proof for PII
